# AgentMesh

> Build AI workflows on a visual canvas, connect models and API tools,
> and monitor run logs and costs.

## What it does

- Build workflows with triggers, agents, models, tools, and actions.
- Choose a model from Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or Mistral.
- Connect HTTP APIs or x402-compatible paid APIs as tools.
- View live run logs, step results, and usage costs.

## x402

- Relay endpoint: https://www.agent-mesh.app/api/x402/relay
- Unpaid requests receive HTTP 402 with payment requirements.
- Read the current price, asset, and network from the payment requirements.
- Use `?target=<url>` to route a request to an x402 endpoint through the relay.
- A request without a target returns the relay's payment requirements.

## Links

- Home: https://www.agent-mesh.app
- Agent card: https://www.agent-mesh.app/.well-known/agent-card.json
